title: Weekly review
summary: The team reviewed Thursday's inbound volume and agreed to move the after-hours overflow onto the second attendant. Ada took the carrier follow-up, Grace is rewriting the greeting, and the routing change lands before the end of the week. A second pass on the transfer directory was deferred to the next session.
transcript:
Ada: Inbound is up about a third on Thursdays.
Grace: The greeting is the part callers stumble on.
Ada: I will take the carrier follow-up.

actionItems.text: Move after-hours overflow to the second attendant
